prompt: Generate one original pixel art sprite for a Japanese 2D side-scrolling RPG based on the character in these two in-game Treasure Hoarder Scout reference images, no copying of source pixels. Truly transparent background. Single centered full-body sprite, both boot soles fully visible and level, no shadows on floor, no captions, no animation sheet. Orient face and torso THREE-QUARTER LEFT (looking towards screen left), ready relaxed guard with one slightly larger raised hand and feet apart, no held weapon in idle; clearly visible small belt sheath and pouch. Preserve sandy blond short messy hair, olive brown cloth triangle mask covering nose/mouth, white rolled-sleeve shirt, brown diagonal strap, broad dark belt with square silver buckle, olive-grey cropped trousers, wrist wraps and dark leather lace-up boots. Use classic 2D MMORPG chibi readable silhouette, approximately 2.95 heads tall in actual chibi anatomy, head about 30-34 percent of full body, short torso, short knees and lower legs, slightly broad shoulders, sturdy hands and boots. Hard square pixel clusters and crisp dark warm outlines, no gradients, maximum ~26 distinct colors, designed to reduce to an 88 px tall runtime sprite, especially legible smaller as 44 px/16 colors. Maintain pale shirt and olive pants separation. Use background alpha around entire silhouette. Do not include level scene, source screenshot UI, second character, watermark, text, or stylized lettering.
limits: Left three-quarter still shared by the three generic camp enemies. Separate direction and motion art deferred. Rectangle counts do not measure game performance.
